label: stopped-run close-out (D148/D149)
rule: Outputs derived with the run script's own _winners_and_error_history and _finalize from the journal as-is; the journal was not resumed, edited, or given an exit record.
retry_errored: _retry_errored not run: verified no-op for this journal — no repo's latest attempt carries an 'error' (ERRORED = 0), so the pass would re-screen nothing.
authenticated_basis: A _finalize input the journal header does not carry; the run's sessions executed with a GitHub token (GH_TOKEN), as recorded in the run record.
